integrity: The universal planar statement is proved analytically from a translate-intersection lemma for strictly convex planar bodies and the published exact modified von Neumann--Jordan constant. Finite numerical optimization was used only as a stress test and not as proof.
scientific_limitations: The structural identity is restricted to real strictly convex normed planes. It is not asserted in dimension at least three, where distinct centered chords can share a midpoint. The explicit classical-space corollary concerns only two-dimensional \(\ell_p\).
title: Inscribed-quadrilateral collapse in strictly convex normed planes
